summary.intent: Resolve all PR review threads on PR #342 and ensure the SDK test suite passes cleanly.
summary.outcome: All 10 review threads resolved (7 original + 3 new), 5 code fixes committed including mock corrections and a new partial failure test, and all 5 concurrency unit tests pass.

repo: cipher-box SDK lives at packages/sdk/src with tests in __tests__/
Integration tests require a running API on port 3000; unit tests run independently
PR #342 involves upload concurrency logic and asymmetric batch failure handling

code.finding: Mocks needed correction and a partial failure test case was missing; after fixes all 5 concurrency tests pass
batchResult.reason must be normalized to an Error object before use
Fulfilled results need a totalFailed > 0 guard to avoid false success reporting
DB fallback + TEE republish is intentional design; retry queue handling is a planned follow-up

workflow: CodeRabbit and Copilot are both active reviewers on this repo and generate separate thread batches
Resolving threads in batches can miss new ones added concurrently; a follow-up check is necessary
Integration tests failing due to ECONNREFUSED are expected when API is not running and should not be treated as regressions

friction: Port 3000 was occupied by a leftover API process from earlier load testing, blocking pnpm dev
3 new review threads appeared after the initial resolution pass, requiring a second round of fixes
Integration tests always fail in this environment without a running API, adding noise to test output
open_items: Retry queue follow-up for the DB fallback + TEE republish design (noted in thread 7 response)
Integration tests are not runnable locally without a live API; no local dev setup documented for this
